# WordPress Plugin Review Checker

> Free, browser-local checker for WordPress plugin developers: catches a readme.txt Stable tag that doesn't match your plugin's Version header, missing required readme/header fields, unescaped $_GET/$_POST output, and $_POST handling with no nonce check -- before wordpress.org Plugin Review does. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
